name: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd
about: Himadri Speciality Chemical is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of carbon materials and chemicals.[1] It is the No.1 coal pitch manufacturer in India and is the only company to manufacture advanced carbon material in India. It is also the largest player of Naphthalene and SNF in India.[2]
keyPoints: Product Portfolio[1][2] The company is a key player across various product segments, including LFP Cathode Active Material, Anode Materials, Silicon Carbon for Anodes, Carbon Black, Speciality Carbon Black, OHT, PCR, EV, CV & other speciality tyres, Coal Tar Pitch, High purity naphthalene, Carbazole, Anthraquinone, Speciality oils, SNF / PCE, Naphthalene balls, Clean power and Resource Extraction.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 73.7% CAGR over last 5 years
